title: Create a practical course registration form that can be used for feedback on this page
goal: combines access tags, native format verification and same-page status prompts.
summary: practical classes are provided in two sessions. Complete the form semantics and local receipt process so that applicants can complete operations using the keyboard and receive clear feedback.
tasks: associates three labels, adding name and required for #name, #email and #course. The mailbox uses the email type.
Set role="status" for #reply to publish submission results.
On form submission, use FormData to read the trimmed name and selected session. Set #reply to “NAME, registered for: SESSION”. Show “Please enter a valid name” for a blank name.

example.note: label binding control, name is used for submission. role="status" is suitable for reading general result feedback.

hint: The browser will trigger submit after passing the native verification and look for the corresponding three field names in FormData.
